title: Warm Spiced Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A cultured and festive Algerian dish featuring lamb, dark soy sauce, and dashi extract, friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences. This recipe combines the warmth of spices with the richness of lamb.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dark soy sauce and dashi extract, and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
